scenicChapters.title: Grindon School Roman temporary camp → Bewcastle Roman fort
scenicChapters.narrative: Speed drops and stays down. Park rather than crawl through. 34 km through ground somebody thought worth listing. The road passes it rather than bypassing it.

places-grindon-school-roman-temporary-ca.story: From Haydon Bridge it runs 284 km to Haydon Bridge; allow about 4 h 54 of riding. It goes by way of Bewcastle Roman fort, Hadrian's Wall and vallum in wall mile 66, Skinburness and Burrow Walls Roman fort. The line favours views over speed.
